principle: EVERY JOURNEY SHOULD BE SAFER BECAUSE IZAKHONO NAV IS PRESENT.
safety_rules: Safety takes priority over fastest-only routing.
Emergency workflows must never falsely imply live emergency dispatch until integrated and verified.
Hands-free interaction should minimize driver distraction.
Offline-ready behavior must preserve core journey state when connectivity drops.
External infrastructure must remain replaceable by IZAKHONO-owned infrastructure.
Never fabricate a road-risk score when verified hazard data is unavailable.

route_scoring.description: A transparent scoring contract for comparing route alternatives before live African road-risk feeds are connected.
rules: Verified hazards may increase route risk and trigger a safer alternative.
Road-class data may distinguish major roads from minor or unclassified roads when available.
Connectivity resilience should favor routes that retain navigation capability offline.
If hazard or road-class data is missing, mark the score as provisional rather than inventing certainty.
Fastest route is not automatically the recommended route.

next_engineering_layers: Real map rendering and route geometry — implemented
